name: Royal Exchange Plc
source: Royal Exchange Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, Group Five Year Financial Summary pages 90 and 91, printed in thousands of naira; values stored below as absolute naira. The top line is the printed Net income figure for the insurance group. Rows the summary does not print are left absent. | CRON 20261005: added Operating Expenses and Operating Profit (EBIT) from the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 36 of the FY2025 annual report (Group column, thousands of naira stored as absolute naira): operating income 1,660,808 less impairment charge 154,594 less personnel expenses 221,079 less operating expenses 417,681 equals 867,454 profit before tax, and FY2024 is 1,575,142 less a 38,687 write-back less 179,077 less 405,714 equals 1,029,038. Corrected FY2025 Income Tax to 16,027,000 (minimum tax 4,246 plus income taxes 11,781) and Net Profit to 851,427,000, with Net Margin, ROE and ROA recomputed: the printed statement of profit or loss and the statement of value added on page 90 both state profit for the year 851,427 after tax of 16,027, while the five year financial summary on page 92 carries profit before tax 867,454 down as profit after taxation with a blank tax line. The primary audited statement is used.
